QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_20

question.text: Yamuna AIF drew INR 50 crore at t=0. Over 5 years, its terminal distribution (ignoring fees) is INR 70 crore. Approximate Gross IRR?

explanation.text: The Logic: Solve 50 = 70/(1+IRR)^5, giving (1+IRR)^5 = 1.40. Taking the 5th root: 1+IRR ≈ 1.0696, so IRR ≈ 6.96%. This follows the single outflow/inflow Gross IRR formula in Example 7.1. The Trap: 8% rounds up. 4% is too low. 10% is a hurdle-rate distractor, not the IRR. Note: The single outflow/inflow formula IRR = (FV/PV)^(1/n) - 1 is the standard quick calculation for a fund with one inflow and one outflow.
